turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hi. Is everything okay with your drink?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I ordered a hot coffee, but this is cold tea.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. I can make your coffee again, but it will take ten minutes.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need to leave in five minutes. Is there something quicker?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I can make you a medium one right now and give you a dollar back, or I can give you a full refund.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Can I have the medium with milk and no sugar?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Yes, of course. Would that work for you?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, I'll take that, please. I still want a coffee before I go.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Medium coffee with milk, no sugar, and one dollar back. Sorry about that.
